explication: Apache NuttX is a small-footprint, POSIX-oriented RTOS for embedded systems. Its user-facing workflow is application code using OS interfaces to access hardware and services; the supplied tree shows examples including AI-engine control, USB mass storage and Xbox input, audio, and multicast listener handling. ARM support spans architecture-specific exception and interrupt code plus many chip-family drivers. The excerpts do not expose the kernel’s general syscall, scheduler, filesystem, or device-registration implementations, so those connections are not inferred here.
